requirements.quote: In an effort to promote and assist in the participation of certified M/WBEs as subcontractors and suppliers on this project for the provision of services and materials, the bidder is required to comply with SRAA’s participation goals through one of the three methods below.
requirements.text: Bidder must comply with SRAA's M/WBE participation goals through one of three specified methods.

requirements.quote:  Full Participation – No Request for Waiver (PREFERRED)
requirements.text: Bidder can choose full participation with no waiver request.

requirements.quote:  Partial Participation – Partial Request for Waiver
requirements.text: Bidder can choose partial participation with a partial waiver request.

requirements.quote:  No Participation – Request for Complete Waiver
requirements.text: Bidder can choose no participation with a complete waiver request.

requirements.quote: By my signature on this Cover Letter, I certify that I am authorized to bid the Bidder’s firm contractually
requirements.text: Authorized representative must certify their authority to bid on behalf of the firm.
